title: 9. Image Credits
intro: Who made each photograph, micrograph and historical drawing on the Computational Cortical Columns pages, under what licence they are shared, and where the originals are. The diagrams drawn for this library (the SVG figures) are not listed: they are our own.

blocks.text: Every image below comes from Wikimedia Commons and is either in the public domain or shared under a Creative Commons licence. Each figure caption names the author and licence in short; this page gives the full credit, the address of the original file page (where the full licence text and any later corrections live) and what was changed for this library, which the CC BY licences ask for. Public domain and CC0 images need no credit, but they are listed too so you can find the originals.

Share-alike: three of the images (the orientation and ocular dominance map, the Golgi-stained hippocampal pyramidal neuron and the grid-cell recording) are under CC BY-SA licences. You may reuse them, changed or not, but anything you make from them has to be shared under the same licence (or a compatible later version) and must credit the author. Our copies were only resized, trimmed or recoloured, and they are shared here under their original CC BY-SA licence. That covers only these image files, not the text of the pages around them.

blocks.text: To reuse an image, take it from its Commons page rather than from this library, so you get the full-resolution original and its current licence. Credit it the way the captions here do: the author, the licence with a link to it, and the source, plus a note of anything you changed. The same list, kept next to the image files, is in assets/figures/computational-cortical-columns/CREDITS.md in the repository.
Sources: the Wikimedia Commons file page of each image, given above; the Creative Commons licence deeds (creativecommons.org/licenses); assets/figures/computational-cortical-columns/CREDITS.md.
